ಸುಂದರ:
==Kannada==

===Etymology===
Borrowed from {{bor|kn|sa|सुन्दर}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{kn-IPA|ಸುಂದರ}}

===Noun===
{{kn-noun|g=n}}
# [[beauty]]
# a [[beautiful]] person or thing

====Usage notes====
* When used to refer to a person, this word takes gendered suffixes: {{l|kn|ಸುಂದರನು|tr=sundaranu}} for a man and {{l|kn|ಸುಂದರಿ|tr=sundari}} for a woman.

====Derived terms====
* {{l|kn|ಸುಂದರವಾದ||beautiful|tr=sundaravāda}} (adjective)

====Related terms====
* {{l|kn|ಸುಂದರಿ|tr=sundari|t=beautiful woman}}

====Declension====
{{kn-decl-a|ಸುಂದರ}}

===References===
* {{R:kn:Alar}}
ಮೇಣದಬತ್ತಿ:
==Kannada==

===Etymology===
Compound of {{compound|kn|ಮೇಣ|t1=wax|ಬತ್ತಿ|t2=wick}}. Both components are standard Kannada; {{m|kn|ಮೇಣ}} is Dravidian, while {{m|kn|ಬತ್ತಿ}} is borrowed from Indo-Aryan.

===Pronunciation===
* {{kn-IPA|ಮೇಣದಬತ್ತಿ}}

===Noun===
{{kn-noun|g=n}}
# [[candle]]
#: {{ux|kn|ಅವಳು ಒಂದು '''ಮೇಣದಬತ್ತಿ'''ಯನ್ನು ಹಚ್ಚಿದಳು.|tr=Avaḷu ondu '''mēṇadabatti'''yannu haccidaḷu.|t=She lit a '''candle'''.}}

====Declension====
{{kn-decl-e-i-ai|ಮೇಣದಬತ್ತಿ|ಮೇಣದಬತ್ತಿ}}

* V. Krishna (2019), “ಬತ್ತಿ”, in “Alar” V. Krishna's Kannada → English dictionary, Zerodha
